notes.value: GUGO Box, a compact electric hatchback imported by GUGO Motors (the same car Chawla Green Motors sells as the Dongfeng Box). Three trims after the April 2025 price cut: E1 Eco PKR 5,700,000 with a 31.4 kWh LFP battery and 330 km CLTC; E2 Plus PKR 6,300,000 and E3 Premium PKR 6,650,000 with 42.3 kWh and 430 km CLTC. 70 kW (about 95 hp) front motor, 160 Nm, 0–100 km/h 12.5 s on the E1 (10.6 s on the larger battery), 140 km/h. AC 6.6 kW; DC 50 kW with 10–80% in about 30 minutes; CCS2 and Type 2. 4,020–4,030 × 1,810 × 1,570 mm on a 2,660 mm wheelbase, 160 mm ground clearance, 326 L boot, 1,235–1,320 kg, 5 seats. PakNEV estimates 238–302 km in real-world use. Equipment ranges from dual airbags, ESC, a 5-inch driver display, keyless entry, auto climate and a reversing camera on the E1 to a 12-inch floating touchscreen, 360° camera, forward collision warning, lane keep assist and adaptive LED headlights on the E3. Warranty is quoted by one source as 2 years / 100,000 km on the vehicle and 4 years / 150,000 km on the battery; confirm with GUGO. Sources: PakNEV, PakWheels, Gari.pk, ProPakistani.

notes.value: GUGO GIGI 220, a three-door micro electric car, per GUGO Motors' brochure: 30 kW (40 hp) / 100 Nm permanent-magnet motor driving the rear wheels, 16.8 kWh lithium-iron-phosphate battery (112 V), 220 km NEDC, 100 km/h, 0–50 km/h in 5.2 s. Charges at 3.3 kW in 4–5 hours from a home socket; there is no DC fast charging. A 5 kW solar parking shed is offered as an option. 3,030 × 1,495 × 1,640 mm on a 1,960 mm wheelbase, 135 mm ground clearance, 145/60 R13 alloys, MacPherson front and multi-link rear suspension, about 815 kg, four seats with 50:50 folding rear seats (GUGO quotes 843 L of load space with them folded). Equipment: driver airbag, ABS with EBD, ESC, traction control, auto hold, TPMS, ISOFIX, reversing camera and rear parking radar, keyless entry and start, cruise control, a 7-inch digital cluster and 8.8-inch touchscreen, automatic climate control and electric mirrors. PKR 3,750,000. Sources: GUGO Motors brochure, PakNEV.
